title: Essential surjectivity from normalized etale line frames
statement: Let X be a scheme and A a functor from its ordinary invertible modules to its etale line modules [def-trf-scheme-etale-line-comparison-data]. Suppose additive-sheaf isomorphisms alpha_L identify A(L) with the canonical tensor-section sheaf, respecting scalar multiplication on each etale object. Then every etale line module is isomorphic to A(L) for some ordinary invertible L.

source.place: Tag 03DX (proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent), part (2); Tag 05VG (lemma-equivalence-quasi-coherent-properties), finite local freeness, specialized to rank one; Tag 03LC (proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent-functorial), part (1), for pullback compatibility. The equivalence is restricted to invertible modules.

proof.text: Choose local frames from the defining CoversTop family of a line module G. CoversTop evaluated on the identity etale object gives a jointly surjective family. [lem-trf-etale-line-frame-transition-units] supplies overlap units. Its formula and cancellation of each frame give the frame equation on every test object. Cancel frames again to prove the triple cocycle and diagonal identities there. Apply [lem-trf-etale-framed-line-effective-gluing] to obtain invertible L and a scalar-linear additive-sheaf isomorphism from its tensor sections to G. Compose alpha with that isomorphism, lift componentwise linear maps and their inverses to a module-sheaf isomorphism, and then lift to the full subcategory. No nonemptiness or finiteness of the covering family is used.

lean.statement: theorem etale_line_sections_essSurj {X : Scheme.{u}} (A : TrfInvertibleModules X ⥤ TrfEtaleLineModules X) (α : ∀ L : TrfInvertibleModules X, trfLineSections (A.obj L) ≅ trfInvertibleSections L) (hscalar : ∀ (L : TrfInvertibleModules X) (U : X.Etale) (r : Γ(U.left, ⊤)) (s : (A.obj L).obj.val.obj (op U)), (α L).hom.hom.app (op U) (r • s) = (((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj L.obj).smul r).hom ((α L).hom.hom.app (op U) s)) : A.EssSurj
